items.content: How healthcare organizations use Claude Tag
items.contentSnippet: How healthcare organizations use Claude Tag

summaries.zh:
医疗组织如何使用Claude Tag  

Claude Tag是一种标签工具，医疗组织利用它对医疗数据进行分类和管理。通过该工具，组织可以高效整理病历、影像资料等，便于检索和共享。此外，Claude Tag还能辅助数据分析和报告生成，提升工作效率。该工具的应用有助于优化医疗资源分配，促进信息化建设。
summaries.en: Healthcare organizations utilize Claude Tag to streamline data management and enhance patient care. The tool facilitates secure sharing of medical records, improves communication among staff, and ensures compliance with healthcare regulations. By centralizing patient information, Claude Tag enables efficient access to critical data, reducing errors and improving workflow. Its integration with existing systems enhances productivity while maintaining data integrity. The platform also supports analytics, aiding in better decision-making for treatment plans and resource allocation. Overall, Claude Tag enhances operational efficiency and patient outcomes in healthcare settings.

items.title: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here’s how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic

summaries.zh: 自动化编码给持续集成（CI）带来压力。Anthropic公司通过扩展测试影响分析来解决这个问题。他们优化了分析工具，提高了测试效率，确保代码变更能快速验证。此举有效减轻了CI负担，提升了开发流程稳定性。
summaries.en: Agentic coding is increasing pressure on Continuous Integration (CI) systems. Anthropic addressed this by scaling test impact analysis. The approach involves automating the process to identify which tests need re-running after code changes, improving efficiency and reducing unnecessary test executions. This helps maintain CI performance while supporting more complex development workflows.

The platform aims to enhance productivity by leveraging both AI capabilities and human expertise, creating a balanced system. This shift positions monday.com as a leader in hybrid work environments, combining technology and human intelligence to streamline operations.
